title: BitwrapChartClaim
description: "I charted this track" (shown as "charted by"): credit for the first find, like naming a comet. A track is fully determined by (genre, seed, structure); its CID is the CID of that beats-snapshot.v1 document. Attribution only: no ownership, the track stays CC0. A feature blob: it references the identity tree (the charting member's membership, by an identity-log row) but is never a leaf of it. Claims are batched into their own OZ Merkle roots in the claim log; the earliest included claim (smallest claim seq) wins.

id.description: The track: ipfs:// plus the CID of its beats-snapshot.v1 document.

member.description: An identity-log row at or after the one that sealed the charter's signup: the claim's reference into the identity tree.

render.description: Evidence the track was rendered: the engine that rendered it and the sha2-256 of its deterministic output. Rendering costs real CPU per track, which is the point; the service may re-render a sample to check.

x-rules: the submission carries the track's beats-snapshot.v1 document, whose CID is the one in credentialSubject.id
member.height names an identity-log row with that hash, sealed no earlier than the charter's signup

x-credential.standard: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0; this schema constrains credentialSubject
x-credential.cid: CIDv1 dag-json sha2-256, base58btc, multibase z, of the whole credential (proof included)
